description: Search published salon suites, booths, chairs, and entire salons. city or lat and lng are required. Results sort ok prices first; unusual and invalid prices come last. weeklyPrice is the low end of the posted price converted to USD per week, and is null when the price is invalid. priceQuality is ok, unusual, or invalid (null when no price is posted). Unusual and invalid prices are unverified and are not typical rents; priceNote explains the check, and the owner can confirm the current price. likelyJobAd marks job posts, which are not rentals.
name: search_listings
title: Search salon spaces
